subject: Human Evolution
title: Denisova Cave
description: A quick win: understand Denisova Cave.

hook.text: A single finger bone from a Siberian cave in 2010 revealed an unknown human species through DNA alone.

buildup.text: Denisova Cave's cool, dry conditions preserved ancient DNA far better than most tropical sites.

discovery.text: The Denisovans were genetically distinct from both Neanderthals and modern humans—a third lineage.

twist.text: We have almost no Denisovan fossils, yet their DNA lives in billions of people across Asia and Oceania.

climax.text: Denisovans proved that genetics can discover species that fossils alone never revealed.

punchline.text: One bone, one genome, one new species.
